answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a forge bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every dawn settlement recomputes the umber schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
